sections.overview: This Colombian eartheater is recorded from the Atrato, San Juan and Baudó river basins in the Chocó region.
sections.identification: The species was described from the Río San Juan at Tadó, in present-day Chocó Department.
sections.habitat: A study in the Tutunendo River examined stomach contents of this fish, but the abstract does not characterize a full habitat preference.
sections.diet: In the Tutunendo sample, stomach contents indicated zooplanktivory, especially consumption of aquatic insect larvae.
sections.behavior: The available study reports feeding ecology rather than social behaviour.
sections.reproduction: The species summaries consulted do not establish its reproductive behaviour.
sections.ecology: Its western Colombian range is separate from the Orinoco and Guianan Geophagus in this group of profiles.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports Data Deficient, assessed on 8 October 2014.
